title: Make the scope of a multi-document save explicit
goal: Choose Cosmos save transaction behavior when several document changes must succeed together within one container and partition.

selectionNotes: Choose Cosmos save transaction behavior when several document changes must succeed together within one container and partition.

Actual same-partition save success and conflict rollback, cross-partition and cross-container mode outcomes; previous-release explicit SDK batch success and conflict rollback. No global transaction claim.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: EF Core 11 requires net11.0; no EF11-on-net10.0 route is offered.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build the declared target. Exact recorded SDKs are verification baselines; current-release proof uses RC2, not GA.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Declared sample language mode; no C#15-specific syntax is required.

frameworks: Standalone Microsoft.NET.Sdk console; no web framework requirement

packages.name: Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos
packages.reason: Independent document read-back and approved emulator transport; both comparison consumers pin this SDK.

packages.name: Newtonsoft.Json
packages.reason: JObject/JArray document-shape inspection; both comparison consumers pin this package.

packageAssets: EF Cosmos11 lib/net11.0; EF Cosmos10 lib/net10.0. Both consumers select Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos3.63.1 lib/netstandard2.0 (Client, Core, Direct and Serialization.HybridRow) and Newtonsoft.Json13.0.4 lib/net6.0. Full transitive and native assets are pinned by each package lock.
providers: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Cosmos11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105 and Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos3.63.1 against the approved legacy Linux NoSQL emulator2.14.28.0, loopback HTTPS gateway and a uniquely marked playbook_ database. No cloud/account parity.
platforms: Windows x64 actual execution; other platforms unverified
renderingModes: Not applicable: console/database consumer; no renderer or browser
constraints: Cosmos account/container capabilities are prerequisites. Verify new container policy before use; EnsureCreated is not a migration mechanism.
Transactions are bounded by one container and complete partition key, 100 operations and 2 MB. Automatic batching is not global atomicity.
Comparison samples add no .NET10 foundation or target10 edition.
prerequisites: Copy the complete sample project and restore its exact package/SDK pins.
Use eng/Test-CosmosPolicies.ps1 -Record with the approved disposable local emulator. No cloud resources or production data.
stabilityLimitations: Stable API contract prepared using .NET11 RC2 SDK/runtime/EF packages; no experimental opt-in. Actual GA reconciliation remains outstanding.

evidence.scope: Actual same-partition save success and conflict rollback, cross-partition and cross-container mode outcomes; previous-release explicit SDK batch success and conflict rollback. No global transaction claim.
